message.content: {"A0100":"A0100 most plausibly seeks to reduce post-launch exposure while preserving energy by extending steadily east at level altitude and increasing speed, rather than turning toward the southbound opponents; its own missile is already advancing north, while two opposing missiles continue southeast from the north.","A0200":"A0200 most plausibly seeks to escape the converging missile corridor by sustaining a hard right turn into an east-southeast descent, creating lateral and vertical separation while retaining speed; the maneuver begins with two opposing missiles approaching from the north and continues after B0200 becomes inactive."}

answers.A0100: A0100 most plausibly seeks to reduce post-launch exposure while preserving energy by extending steadily east at level altitude and increasing speed, rather than turning toward the southbound opponents; its own missile is already advancing north, while two opposing missiles continue southeast from the north.
answers.A0200: A0200 most plausibly seeks to escape the converging missile corridor by sustaining a hard right turn into an east-southeast descent, creating lateral and vertical separation while retaining speed; the maneuver begins with two opposing missiles approaching from the north and continues after B0200 becomes inactive.
